correctness.rationale: The source local estimate gives \(G_r(\zeta)=F(w_r+A\zeta/L_r)/F(w_r)\to e^{\zeta}\) locally uniformly, and Cauchy estimates give local uniform derivative convergence. For \(R<R_1<\pi\), a hypothetical sequence of collisions in \(|\zeta|\le R\) has a convergent subsequence. Distinct limiting points would contradict injectivity of \(e^z\) on the centered disk of radius \(R_1<\pi\); coalescing points contradict the nonzero limit of the integrated difference quotient. For \(F(z)=\exp(e^z)\), the two symmetric scaled points corresponding to imaginary shifts \(\pm i\arcsin(\pi e^{-r})\) have equal values and radius \(e^r\arcsin(\pi e^{-r})\to\pi\). The MDPI primary article explicitly includes iterated exponentials in the admissible class.
